title: Size the corpus
intro: The issue's rule of thumb: a retirement corpus of about 25× your annual spending. A household spends ₹54 lakh a year.
prompt: Using the 25× rule, what corpus (₹ crore) does ₹54 lakh a year of spending call for?
debrief: 25 × ₹54 lakh = ₹13.5 crore — an estimate, not a guarantee (aim higher for lifestyle growth or cushion). And September's sharper correction comes BEFORE this multiplication: subtract the promised-away money first. If a fifth of your headline corpus is committed — a loan running past retirement, a wedding, a parent's care — the multiple on what remains must rise (350× monthly becomes ~438×). Run the rule on the number that's actually yours.
